solves: Shows an applied filter, a value chosen in a field or a quick filter that the person checks and unchecks, in a small rounded piece with one action.
use_when: With type removable, for a filter already applied or a value chosen that the person can take away.
With type selectable, for a quick filter that the person checks and unchecks; several can stay checked.
With a status severity, when the value of the filter is a status; the label says which.
With an icon, to recognize the type of the filter; with an avatar, when the value is a person; with a counter, to show how many items the option has before the click.
With size compact in the toolbar, the table and the field; with size default on a selectable chip inside a form.
do_not_use_when: For a system status with no action: use nph-badge.
To run an action, such as delete the selected: use nph-button.
In a line of chips that scrolls sideways: let the chips wrap.

type.constraint: The Figma `tipo`. removable: the X takes the value away and the body has no action. selectable: a quick filter, the whole chip a toggle button with aria-pressed. Outside the list, the piece draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

severity.constraint: The Figma `cor`. A status color exists only on a removable chip with text content: no icon, no avatar, and none of marked, readonly and invalid. A selectable chip has the default severity only. Outside the list, the piece draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

size.constraint: The Figma `tamanho`: chip/height-compact or chip/height-default. The target of the X is the same in both. Outside the list, the piece draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

text.constraint: The label, already localized, in one line, cut with an ellipsis at chip/max-width; the whole text shows in an nph-tooltip on hover and on keyboard focus (D-3). Without text, the piece draws nothing and emits no error.

icon.constraint: A core name of nph-icon, before the text, decorative. At most one of icon, avatar and counter. A name outside the core draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

avatar.constraint: Draws an nph-avatar in the sm size before the text (D-2), decorative. Removable only, and not with icon or counter. Reflects because the internal CSS selects the start padding by it.

avatar-src.constraint: The photo of the avatar. Without it, the avatar draws the person icon. It needs avatar.

counter.constraint: A whole number from zero up, drawn as a pill after the text (D-1). Selectable only, and not with icon or avatar.

remove-label.constraint: The word the X says before the text, such as Remove filter, so the X reads Remove filter Status: Waiting, as nph-multi-combobox (P96). Required while the X shows on a removable chip: without it, the piece draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

selected.constraint: The checked selectable chip, the Figma `selecionado`. It shows the X as a mark only: the click belongs to the whole chip. A removable chip is never selected. Changing it from code fires nothing.

marked.constraint: The Figma `marcado`: the last chip of a field, ready to leave, with the hover background and the focus ring on the whole chip. Removable, default severity, one state at a time.

readonly.constraint: The Figma `somente leitura`: the value with no X. Removable, default severity, one state at a time. Needs no remove-label.

invalid.constraint: The Figma `inválido`: chip/invalid-background, chip/invalid-border and chip/invalid-foreground; the X takes the error pair on hover and focus (D-4). Removable, default severity, one state at a time. The message belongs to the field.

disabled.constraint: The whole chip at state/disabled-opacity, out of the Tab order, with no click and no balloon. It wins over the other states, with no error.

nph-remove.constraint: Fired on the host (bubbles, composed) only when the person presses the X of a removable chip, with detail { text }. The chip does not remove itself: the consumer does.

nph-selected-change.constraint: Fired on the host (bubbles, composed) only when the person toggles a selectable chip, with detail { selected }, after selected changed. Setting selected from code fires nothing.

removable.choose_when: An applied filter or a chosen value that the person can take away.

selectable.choose_when: A quick filter that the person checks and unchecks with one click.

status.choose_when: A removable chip with text, when the value of the filter is a status.

compact.choose_when: The toolbar, the table and the field.

default.choose_when: A selectable chip inside a form.

removable-rest.changes_for_user: The label in chip/foreground, a border chip/border inside and the X.

x-hover-active.changes_for_user: The X gains the hover background; in a status color, the pair of the status.

x-focus.changes_for_user: Border focus/border and halo focus/halo around the X; in a status color, the focus pair of the status.

marked.changes_for_user: The hover background and the focus ring on the whole chip: the last chip of the field, ready to leave.

invalid.changes_for_user: Border chip/invalid-border and text chip/invalid-foreground; the X takes the error pair on hover and focus (D-4).

selectable-rest.changes_for_user: The label in chip/foreground and, with a counter, the pill on chip/counter-background.

selectable-hover-active.changes_for_user: The hover background and the counter on chip/counter-background-hover.

selectable-focus.changes_for_user: Border focus/border and halo focus/halo around the whole chip.

selected.changes_for_user: The full background, the label in chip/foreground-selected, no border and the X shown as a mark.

disabled.changes_for_user: The whole chip faded, on chip/background-disabled and with no border, out of the Tab order, with no click and no balloon.

business_rules: The removable chip never removes itself: it fires nph-remove and the consumer takes the value away.
The click on the X is not a click on the chip; on a selectable chip the X is a mark, and the click belongs to the whole chip.
A label that does not fit is cut with an ellipsis and shows the whole text in a balloon on hover and on keyboard focus; a label that is not cut takes no focus (D-3).
A chip with no text draws nothing and emits no error.
Disabled wins over the other states, with no error.

tokens.container: chip/background, radius chip/radius, height chip/height-compact or chip/height-default, maximum width chip/max-width, gap chip/gap, border chip/border-width in chip/border drawn inside
tokens.padding: chip/padding-x with text or counter; chip/padding-start-icon with an icon; chip/padding-start-avatar with an avatar; chip/padding-end-remove or chip/padding-end-remove-default with the X; chip/padding-end-counter after the counter
tokens.label: text/label-md in chip/foreground
tokens.status: chip/<status>-background, chip/<status>-border and chip/<status>-foreground, with <status> as success, warning, error, info or help; the X stays in chip/foreground
tokens.marked: chip/background-hover with the focus ring on the whole chip
tokens.invalid: chip/invalid-background, chip/invalid-border, chip/invalid-foreground; the X on chip/error-remove-background-hover, focus ring chip/error-focus-border and chip/error-focus-halo (D-4)
tokens.selected: chip/background-selected, chip/background-selected-hover and chip/foreground-selected, no border
tokens.counter: A pill of its own (D-1): chip/counter-background, chip/counter-background-hover, chip/counter-background-disabled and chip/counter-foreground in text/label-sm, chip/counter-padding-y and chip/counter-padding-x, radius radius/full
tokens.remove: target chip/remove-size, radius chip/remove-radius, background chip/remove-background-hover on hover, focus and active; in a status color, chip/<status>-remove-background-hover
tokens.icons: nph-icon at icon/size-sm; the content icon and the X in chip/foreground, chip/invalid-foreground when invalid and chip/foreground-selected when selected
tokens.focus: border focus/border and halo focus/halo of width focus/ring-width, round as chip/radius; in a status color chip/<status>-focus-border and chip/<status>-focus-halo

ai_hints: Use nph-chip for an applied filter, a value chosen in a field or a quick filter; for a system status with no action, use nph-badge, and to run an action, use nph-button.
Choose removable when the X takes the value away, and selectable when the person checks and unchecks it with one click.
Choose a status severity only when the value of the filter is a status, on a removable chip with text; the label says which.
Choose an avatar when the value is a person, an icon to recognize the type of the filter and a counter to show how many items the option has.
Choose compact in the toolbar, the table and the field, and default on a selectable chip inside a form.
Give text and remove-label already localized: the X reads the word and the text.
Listen to nph-remove to take the value away and to nph-selected-change to apply the quick filter; do not listen to click.
Let the chips wrap in the line; do not put them in a horizontal scroll.

accessibility.semantics: A removable chip is a span with a native button, the X; a selectable chip is a native button with aria-pressed. Icon and avatar are decorative and hidden from the screen reader.
accessibility.accessible_name: The X is named by remove-label and the text, such as Remove filter Status: Waiting. The selectable chip is named by its text and, with a counter, the number: Pending 12.
keyboard: Tab: reaches the X of a removable chip, the whole selectable chip and a cut label; a disabled chip is skipped.
Enter or Space: presses the X (nph-remove) or toggles the selectable chip (nph-selected-change).
Esc: closes the balloon of a cut label.
accessibility.focus: Border focus/border and halo focus/halo, keyboard only: around the X of a removable chip, around the whole chip when selectable, marked or when the cut label has the focus; in a status color, the focus pair of the status.
accessibility.contrast: Text and X pass 4.5:1 over the chip background in every state, in both modes. The border marks the edge of the chip against the page and does not need 3:1, because the text already identifies the piece (WCAG 1.4.11).
accessibility.color_alternative: The selected chip also shows the X and the full background; the status is written in the label; the invalid chip has a red border and a message below the field.

invalid_combinations: A type, a severity or a size outside the lists — the piece draws nothing.
An icon outside the core of nph-icon.
More than one of icon, avatar and counter.
A counter that is not a whole number from zero up.
A removable chip with a counter, or selected.
A selectable chip with an avatar, a status severity, marked, readonly or invalid.
More than one of marked, readonly and invalid.
A status severity with marked, readonly or invalid, or with an icon or an avatar.
A removable chip with an X and no remove-label.
anti_patterns: Using a chip for a system status with no action: use nph-badge.
Using a chip to run an action: use nph-button.
Putting the line of chips in a horizontal scroll: let it wrap.
Marking the selected chip only by color: it also shows the X and the full background.
Using a status severity for something that is not a status.
